# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We are committed to making participation in this project a respectful experience for everyone, regardless of background or identity.

## Our standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment include being considerate, respecting differing viewpoints, accepting constructive feedback, and focusing on what is best for the project and its community.

Examples of unacceptable behavior include harassment, discriminatory language, personal attacks, publishing private information without permission, and disruptive conduct in project spaces.

## Scope and enforcement

This code applies in project spaces and when someone is representing the project. Report conduct concerns privately to the project maintainers through the GitHub repository's contact options. Maintainers will review reports and may remove, edit, or reject contributions that violate this code.

This document is adapted from the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1.
